system.description:
You knead chakra in your lungs to create a cloud of ash, exhaling it, centering it on a point within range, as it fills a 20-foot radius that bends corners. The cloud remains until dispersed by a strong wind or dissipates naturally which takes 1 minute. The ash cloud is a heavily obscured area.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you can spend a bonus action or reaction to ignite the cloud, forcing all creatures within to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6+4 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the damage this jutsu does by 1d6+1 for each rank above C-Rank. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, all creatures that fail their saving throw also gains 2 ranks of the Burned.
